async def check_reminders():
    async with aiosqlite.connect("/workspace/world.db") as db:
        db.row_factory = aiosqlite.Row
        # First, list all reminders to see what's there
        cursor = await db.execute("SELECT * FROM ts_reminders")
        rows = await cursor.fetchall()
        col_names = [desc[0] for desc in cursor.description]
        reminders = [dict(zip(col_names, row)) for row in rows]
        print(f"Total reminders in DB: {len(reminders)}")
        if reminders:
            print(f"Columns: {col_names}")
            for r in reminders[:10]:

        matching = [r for r in reminders if r.get('time') == posix_ts]
        print(f"\nReminders matching POSIX timestamp {posix_ts}: {len(matching)}")
